pr.title: Star items and show only the starred ones

acceptance.evidence: migrations/0002_add_starred.sql adds starred NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 with CHECK. test/starred.test.js 'AC-1' checks that all 3 seeded rows are 0 and that a value of 2 is rejected.
test 'AC-2' expects '★ Second item' with the other items unmarked. src/index.js adds the star only when starred is truthy.
test 'AC-3' stars ids 3 and 1 and expects them listed in id order, with status 200.
test 'AC-4' checks both / and /?show=all return all items in id order.

The code and test 'AC-5' check both links, and the test would fail if either were missing. However, commit 7708b97 edited this item after the go to add 'verified by review: checked by hand', with no recorded owner decision. See the high finding.
test 'AC-6' checks 400 and no <li> for Starred, none, an empty value and __proto__. The code uses Object.hasOwn.
traffic/routes.json contains /?show=starred. test 'AC-7' checks it. scripts/traffic-config-check.mjs now accepts a query string, covered by tests/traffic-config.test.sh.

findings.what: Commit 7708b97 ('Follow-up edits') changed acceptance item AC-5 after the go (2026-10-12). It appended '— verified by review: checked by hand' mid-sentence, which also garbles the item's wording. The spec records no owner decision or date for this change. 'Checked by hand' is not a followable review step, and it conflicts with the test that already covers AC-5.
findings.fix: Revert the AC-5 edit so it matches the text approved at the go. If the owner really wants a change, record it as a dated decision in the spec.

findings.what: The PR says 'Changed after the go: nothing'. That is false: commit 7708b97 edited AC-5 in the spec after the go. The PR also says 'Reviewer: pending' and 'Low findings: none', but these cannot be checked from the repository.
findings.fix: State the AC-5 edit under 'Changed after the go', or revert it and keep the claim.

lenses.note: A spec exists. Its decisions are followed: starred items keep their id order, and the view is a query parameter with no cookie.
All four rows of the states table have a test in test/starred.test.js. AC-5 was edited after the go, which is the high finding.
The tests assert behaviour and would fail on broken code. The traffic fake app was extended, not loosened. I did not run the suite here because CI runs it.
The README mentions ?show=starred. Nothing is stale.
No defects found. Object.hasOwn guards __proto__, and the SQL is built only from a fixed VIEWS table.
Titles are still escaped with escapeHtml. The show value only selects a key from VIEWS, so there is no injection. The traffic route regex now allows ?, but still refuses spaces and #.
The change adds only a plain link and a ★ to the HTML. It touches no stylesheet and no UI framework files.
